description: This file generates an absent student report in an educational ERP system, fetching attendance, leave, and transportation data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the absent student report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: get_absent_students
methods.description: Fetches list of students absent on a given date.

methods.name: get_leave_applications
methods.description: Retrieves students with approved leave overlapping the date.

methods.name: get_transportation_details
methods.description: Gets transportation info for students on a specific date.
